svg.aria-label: One TCP connection through a SOCKS5 inbound and freedom
svg.title: One TCP connection through a SOCKS5 inbound and freedom

g.text: Accept and handshake: bounded by the inbound's handshake_timeout (10s)
Sniffing, only if the inbound lists sniffers: bounded by sniffing.timeout (300ms)
Routing and dialing: bounded by the outbound's dial_timeout (10s)
Relay: until both sides finish, ctx is cancelled, or tcp_idle_timeout (5m) of silence
Solid arrows are calls or client bytes; dashed arrows are returns and replies. A proxy outbound replaces steps 13-15: it dials the proxy server
through its stack and calls the proxy client's ConnectStream, bounded by its handshake_timeout. With block, DialStream returns ErrBlocked and the client stream is closed.
